name: Badlands Steel
old_description: Badlands Steel was born out of a growing need for steel fabrication in the Williston area. We are devoted to providing a high quality products using state-of-the-art equipment to handle all aspects of steel fabrication.
about:
Badlands Steel operates from Williston, North Dakota, where it was established to meet a growing regional demand for steel fabrication. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure, but its origins trace back to a recognized need for comprehensive fabrication services in the Williston area.

The shop fabricates products from carbon steel, aluminum, and stainless steel, offering a range of steel products and services. It describes its equipment as state-of-the-art and capable of handling all aspects of steel fabrication, though specific machinery, facility size, headcount, and production volumes are not publicly detailed.

Badlands Steel serves customers in the oil field, natural gas, industrial, construction, and agriculture sectors. These five industries are explicitly listed on the company’s website as its primary markets.

The company emphasizes a devotion to high-quality products and the use of modern equipment to cover the full scope of fabrication needs, positioning itself as a single-source provider for hard-to-find metal products.
